1	# Finish the experimental currency migration: remaining hardcoded sites
2	
3	## Context
4	
5	Actual has an experimental `currency` feature flag that introduces a `defaultCurrencyCode` synced pref plus `currencySymbolPosition` and `currencySpaceBetweenAmountAndSymbol`. The single reactive abstraction for rendering and parsing money is `useFormat()` at [useFormat.ts](packages/desktop-client/src/hooks/useFormat.ts) — a callable `format(value, 'financial' | 'financial-with-sign' | 'financial-no-decimals' | 'number' | …)` plus `.forEdit(integer)`, `.fromEdit(string)`, `.currency`.
6	
7	**The flag stays in place.** `useFormat` never consults `useFeatureFlag`; when the flag is off, [settings/index.tsx:189-192](packages/desktop-client/src/components/settings/index.tsx#L189-L192) forces `defaultCurrencyCode` to `''`, `getCurrency('')` returns the no-symbol sentinel, and `applyCurrencyStyling` short-circuits. So `format(x, 'financial')` is byte-identical to legacy `integerToCurrency(x)` with the flag off. Migrating a call site is a no-op today and a fix once the flag is on.
8	
9	Commit `59b092269` migrated 13 display sites (transactions, mobile transactions, accounts, modals). Reports were already ~95% migrated on `master` — 31 files under `components/reports/` call `useFormat`, including the non-hook spreadsheets, which take `format` as a parameter.
10	
11	**What remains is two distinct classes of problem**, and the second is bigger than a grep for the legacy display helpers suggests:
12	
13	1. **Legacy display/parse helpers** — 12 desktop-client files still import the currency-unaware globals (`integerToCurrency`, `amountToCurrency`, `currencyToAmount`, `appendDecimals`, …). These read a mutable module global and emit no symbol.
14	2. **Hardcoded 2-decimal arithmetic** — `amountToInteger(x)` / `integerToAmount(x)` default to `decimalPlaces = 2` ([util.ts:541,549](packages/loot-core/src/shared/util.ts#L541)), and several sites do raw `/100` or `*100`. These are _silently wrong today_ for JPY/KRW/IRR (0 decimals), independent of any symbol rendering.
15	
16	Scope for this pass: **desktop-client display and input/parse paths.** The `loot-core` server, public `api`, and `sync-server` surfaces are catalogued at the end as a separate follow-up — they have no hook access and touch a public API contract and ~20 bank integrations.

129	export function findSortDown<T extends { id: string }>(
130	  arr: T[],
131	  pos: DropPosition | null,
132	  targetId: string,
133	) {
134	  if (pos === 'top') {
135	    return { targetId };
136	  } else {
137	    const idx = arr.findIndex(item => item.id === targetId);
138	
139	    if (idx === -1) {
140	      throw new Error('findSort: item not found: ' + targetId);
141	    }
142	
143	    const newIdx = idx + 1;
144	    if (newIdx < arr.length) {
145	      return { targetId: arr[newIdx].id };
146	    } else {
147	      // Move to the end
148	      return { targetId: null };
149	    }
150	  }
151	}

153	export function findSortUp<T extends { id: string }>(
154	  arr: T[],
155	  pos: DropPosition | null,
156	  targetId: string,
157	) {
158	  if (pos === 'bottom') {
159	    return { targetId };
160	  } else {
161	    const idx = arr.findIndex(item => item.id === targetId);
162	
163	    if (idx === -1) {
164	      throw new Error('findSort: item not found: ' + targetId);
165	    }
166	
167	    const newIdx = idx - 1;

170	    } else {

173	    }

19	export function accountFilter(
20	  accountId?:
21	    | AccountEntity['id']
22	    | 'onbudget'
23	    | 'offbudget'
24	    | 'closed'
25	    | 'uncategorized',
26	  field = 'account',
27	) {
28	  if (accountId) {
29	    if (accountId === 'onbudget') {
30	      return {
31	        $and: [
32	          { [`${field}.offbudget`]: false },
33	          { [`${field}.closed`]: false },
34	        ],
35	      };
36	    } else if (accountId === 'offbudget') {
37	      return {
38	        $and: [
39	          { [`${field}.offbudget`]: true },
40	          { [`${field}.closed`]: false },
41	        ],
42	      };
43	    } else if (accountId === 'closed') {
44	      return { [`${field}.closed`]: true };
45	    } else if (accountId === 'uncategorized') {
46	      return {
47	        [`${field}.offbudget`]: false,
48	        category: null,
49	        is_parent: false,
50	        $or: [
51	          {
52	            'payee.transfer_acct.offbudget': true,
53	            'payee.transfer_acct': null,
54	          },
55	        ],
56	      };
57	    } else {
58	      return { [field]: accountId };
59	    }
60	  }
61	
62	  return null;
63	}
64	
65	export function transactions(
66	  accountId?:
67	    | AccountEntity['id']
68	    | 'onbudget'
69	    | 'offbudget'
70	    | 'closed'
71	    | 'uncategorized',

83	export function transactionsSearch(
84	  currentQuery: Query,
85	  search: string,
86	  dateFormat: SyncedPrefs['dateFormat'],
87	) {
88	  const amount = currencyToAmount(search);
89	  const escapedSearch = search.replace(/[\\%?]/g, '\\$&');
90	
91	  // Support various date formats
92	  let parsedDate;
93	  if (getDayMonthRegex(dateFormat).test(search)) {
94	    parsedDate = parseDate(search, getDayMonthFormat(dateFormat), new Date());
95	  } else if (getShortYearRegex(dateFormat).test(search)) {
96	    parsedDate = parseDate(search, getShortYearFormat(dateFormat), new Date());
97	  } else {
98	    parsedDate = parseDate(search, dateFormat, new Date());
99	  }
100	
101	  return currentQuery.filter({
102	    $or: {
103	      'payee.name': { $like: `%${escapedSearch}%` },
104	      'payee.transfer_acct.name': { $like: `%${escapedSearch}%` },
105	      notes: { $like: `%${escapedSearch}%` },
106	      'category.name': { $like: `%${escapedSearch}%` },
107	      'account.name': { $like: `%${escapedSearch}%` },
108	      $or: [
109	        isDateValid(parsedDate) && { date: dayFromDate(parsedDate) },
110	        amount != null && {
111	          amount: { $transform: '$abs', $eq: amountToInteger(amount) },
112	        },
113	        amount != null &&
114	          Number.isInteger(amount) && {
115	            amount: {
116	              $transform: { $abs: { $idiv: ['$', 100] } },
117	              $eq: amount,
118	            },
119	          },
120	      ].filter(Boolean),
121	    },
122	  });
123	}
124

130	      {
131	        'payee.transfer_acct.offbudget': true,
132	        'payee.transfer_acct': null,
133	      },
134	    ],
135	  });
136	}

131	export function useFormulaExecution(
132	  formula: string,
133	  queries: QueriesMap,
134	  queriesVersion?: number,
135	  namedExpressions?: Record<string, number | string>,
136	) {

139	  const [result, setResult] = useState<number | string | null>(null);

144	    let cancelled = false;
145	
146	    async function executeFormula() {

150	        return;
151	      }
152	
153	      setIsLoading(true);
154	      setError(null);
155	
156	      try {

159	        const formulaLocale = language || browserLocale || locale || 'en-US';

178	          namedExpressions,

181	
182	        await prefetchFormulaQueries(formulaQueryContext, queries);
183	
184	        formulaQueryContext.budgetQueryRequests.clear();
185	        evaluateFormulaWithContext({

189	          namedExpressions,
190	          throwOnCellError: false,
191	        });
192	
193	        await prefetchBudgetQueries(formulaQueryContext);
194	
195	        const cellValue = evaluateFormulaWithContext({
196	          formula,
197	          formulaQueryContext,
198	          locale: formulaLocale,
199	          namedExpressions,
200	        });
201	
202	        if (cancelled) return;
203

210	        setResult(null);
211	      } finally {

213	          setIsLoading(false);

215	      }

218	    void executeFormula();

329	
330	  // Add date range filter if provided
331	  if (timeFrame && timeFrame.mode) {
332	    const [calculatedStart, calculatedEnd] = calculateTimeRange(timeFrame);
333	    const startDate = normalizeQueryTimeFrameStart(calculatedStart);
334	    const endDate = normalizeQueryTimeFrameEnd(calculatedEnd);
335	
336	    transQuery = transQuery.filter({
337	      $and: [{ date: { $gte: startDate } }, { date: { $lte: endDate } }],
338	    });
339	  }
340	
341	  // Add user-defined filters
342	  if (queryFilters.length > 0) {
343	    transQuery = transQuery.filter({ [conditionsOpKey]: queryFilters });
344	  }
345	
346	  return transQuery;
347	}

373	// Helper: Extract category-based conditions (ignore transaction-specific filters)
374	function extractCategoryConditions(
375	  conditions: RuleConditionEntity[],
376	): RuleConditionEntity[] {
377	  return conditions.filter(
378	    cond =>
379	      !cond.customName &&
380	      (cond.field === 'category' || cond.field === 'category_group'),
381	  );
382	}
383	
384	// Helper: Evaluate category conditions to get matching categories
385	async function getCategoriesFromConditions(
386	  allCategories: CategoryEntity[],
387	  conditions: RuleConditionEntity[],
388	  conditionsOp: 'and' | 'or',
389	): Promise<string[]> {
390	  if (conditions.length === 0) {
391	    // No category filter: include all non-income, non-hidden categories
392	    return allCategories
393	      .filter((cat: CategoryEntity) => !cat.is_income && !cat.hidden)
394	      .map((cat: CategoryEntity) => cat.id);
395	  }
396	
397	  // Get category groups for resolving group IDs to names
398	  const { grouped: categoryGroups } = await send('get-categories');
399	  const groupNameById = new Map(
400	    categoryGroups.map((g: { id: string; name: string }) => [g.id, g.name]),
401	  );
402	
403	  // Evaluate each condition to get sets of matching categories
404	  const conditionResults = conditions.map(cond => {
405	    // For category_group conditions, we check cat.group; for category, we check cat.id
406	    const getKey = (cat: CategoryEntity) =>
407	      cond.field === 'category_group' ? cat.group : cat.id;
408	
409	    const matching = allCategories.filter((cat: CategoryEntity) => {
410	      const key = getKey(cat);
411	
412	      const textValue =
413	        cond.field === 'category_group'
414	          ? (groupNameById.get(key) ?? key)
415	          : cat.name;
416	
417	      if (cond.op === 'is') {
418	        return cond.value === key;
419	      } else if (cond.op === 'isNot') {
420	        return cond.value !== key;
421	      } else if (cond.op === 'oneOf') {
422	        return cond.value.includes(key);
423	      } else if (cond.op === 'notOneOf') {
424	        return !cond.value.includes(key);
425	      } else if (cond.op === 'contains') {
426	        return textValue
427	          .toLowerCase()
428	          .includes((cond.value as string).toLowerCase());
429	      } else if (cond.op === 'doesNotContain') {
430	        return !textValue
431	          .toLowerCase()
432	          .includes((cond.value as string).toLowerCase());
433	      } else if (cond.op === 'matches') {
434	        try {
435	          return new RegExp(cond.value as string, 'i').test(textValue);
436	        } catch (e) {
437	          console.warn('Invalid regexp in matches condition', e);
438	          return false;
439	        }
440	      }
441	      // Unknown operator: exclude category by default and log warning
442	      console.warn(`Unknown category condition operator: ${cond.op}`);
443	      return false;
444	    });
445	    return matching.map((cat: CategoryEntity) => cat.id);
446	  });
447	
448	  if (conditionsOp === 'or') {
449	    // OR: Union of all matching categories
450	    const categoryIds = new Set(conditionResults.flat());
451	    return Array.from(categoryIds);
452	  } else {
453	    // AND: Intersection of all matching categories
454	    if (conditionResults.length === 0) {
455	      return [];
456	    }
457	    const firstSet = new Set(conditionResults[0]);
458	    for (let i = 1; i < conditionResults.length; i++) {
459	      const currentIds = new Set(conditionResults[i]);
460	      // Keep only categories that are in both sets
461	      const toRemove: string[] = [];
462	      firstSet.forEach(id => {
463	        if (!currentIds.has(id)) {
464	          toRemove.push(id);
465	        }
466	      });
467	      toRemove.forEach(id => firstSet.delete(id));
468	    }
469	    return Array.from(firstSet);
470	  }
471	}

548	// Helper: Evaluate budget dimension with already-extracted parameters (used by compositional BUDGET_QUERY)
549	async function fetchBudgetDimensionValueDirect(
550	  dimension: string,
551	  categoryIds: string[],
552	  startMonth: string,
553	  endMonth: string,
554	): Promise<number> {
555	  const allowed = new Set([
556	    'budgeted',
557	    'spent',
558	    'balance_start',
559	    'balance_end',
560	    'goal',
561	  ]);
562	  const dim = dimension.toLowerCase();
563	  if (!allowed.has(dim)) {
564	    throw new Error(`Invalid BUDGET_QUERY dimension: ${dimension}`);
565	  }
566	
567	  const intervals = monthUtils.rangeInclusive(startMonth, endMonth);
568	
569	  // Helper: sum a dimension across all months/categories
570	  const sumDimension = async (fieldPattern: string): Promise<number> => {
571	    let total = 0;
572	    for (const month of intervals) {
573	      const monthData = await getMonthBudgetData(month);
574	      for (const catId of categoryIds) {
575	        total += getMonthDataValue(monthData, fieldPattern, catId) as number;
576	      }
577	    }
578	    return total;
579	  };
580	
581	  if (dim === 'budgeted') {
582	    return integerToAmount(await sumDimension('budget-{catId}'), 2);
583	  }
584	
585	  if (dim === 'spent') {
586	    return integerToAmount(await sumDimension('sum-amount-{catId}'), 2);
587	  }
588	
589	  if (dim === 'goal') {
590	    return integerToAmount(await sumDimension('goal-{catId}'), 2);
591	  }
592	
593	  // Handle balance dimensions: chain month-by-month with carryover logic
594	  if (dim === 'balance_start' || dim === 'balance_end') {
595	    let runningBalance = 0;
596	    const monthBeforeStart = monthUtils.subMonths(startMonth, 1);
597	    const prevMonthData = await getMonthBudgetData(monthBeforeStart);
598	
599	    for (const catId of categoryIds) {
600	      const catBalance = getMonthDataValue(
601	        prevMonthData,
602	        'leftover-{catId}',
603	        catId,
604	      ) as number;
605	      const hasCarryover = Boolean(
606	        getMonthDataValue(prevMonthData, 'carryover-{catId}', catId),
607	      );
608	      if (catBalance > 0 || (catBalance < 0 && hasCarryover)) {
609	        runningBalance += catBalance;
610	      }
611	    }
612	
613	    const balances: Record<string, { start: number; end: number }> = {};
614	
615	    for (const month of intervals) {
616	      const monthData = await getMonthBudgetData(month);
617	      let budgeted = 0;
618	      let spent = 0;
619	      let carryoverToNextMonth = 0;
620	
621	      for (const catId of categoryIds) {
622	        const catBudgeted =
623	          Number(getMonthDataValue(monthData, 'budget-{catId}', catId)) || 0;
624	        const catSpent =
625	          Number(getMonthDataValue(monthData, 'sum-amount-{catId}', catId)) ||
626	          0;
627	        const catBalance =
628	          Number(getMonthDataValue(monthData, 'leftover-{catId}', catId)) || 0;
629	        const hasCarryover = Boolean(
630	          getMonthDataValue(monthData, 'carryover-{catId}', catId),
631	        );
632	
633	        budgeted += catBudgeted;
634	        spent += catSpent;
635	
636	        if (catBalance > 0 || (catBalance < 0 && hasCarryover)) {
637	          carryoverToNextMonth += catBalance;
638	        }
639	      }
640	
641	      const balanceStart = runningBalance;
642	      const balanceEnd = budgeted + spent + runningBalance;
643	
644	      balances[month] = { start: balanceStart, end: balanceEnd };
645	      runningBalance = carryoverToNextMonth;
646	    }
647	
648	    if (dim === 'balance_start') {
649	      return integerToAmount(balances[intervals[0]]?.start || 0, 2);
650	    }
651	    return integerToAmount(
652	      balances[intervals[intervals.length - 1]]?.end || 0,
653	      2,
654	    );
655	  }
656	
657	  return 0;
658	}

3	import type { Query } from '@actual-app/core/shared/query';
4	import { debounce } from 'es-toolkit/compat';
5	
6	import * as queries from '#queries';
7	
8	type UseTransactionsSearchProps = {
9	  updateQuery: (updateFn: (searchQuery: Query) => Query) => void;
10	  resetQuery: () => void;
11	  dateFormat: string;
12	  delayMs?: number;
13	};
14	type UseTransactionsSearchResult = {
15	  isSearching: boolean;
16	  search: (searchText: string) => void;
17	};
18	
19	export function useTransactionsSearch({
20	  updateQuery,
21	  resetQuery,
22	  dateFormat,
23	  delayMs = 150,
24	}: UseTransactionsSearchProps): UseTransactionsSearchResult {
25	  const [isSearching, setIsSearching] = useState(false);
26	
27	  const updateQueryRef = useRef(updateQuery);
28	  updateQueryRef.current = updateQuery;
29	
30	  const resetQueryRef = useRef(resetQuery);
31	  resetQueryRef.current = resetQuery;
32	
33	  const updateSearchQuery = useMemo(
34	    () =>
35	      debounce((searchText: string) => {
36	        if (searchText === '') {
37	          resetQueryRef.current?.();
38	          setIsSearching(false);
39	        } else if (searchText) {
40	          resetQueryRef.current?.();
41	          updateQueryRef.current(previousQuery =>
42	            queries.transactionsSearch(previousQuery, searchText, dateFormat),
43	          );
44	          setIsSearching(true);
45	        }
46	      }, delayMs),
47	    [dateFormat, delayMs],
48	  );
49	
50	  useEffect(() => {
51	    return () => updateSearchQuery.cancel();
52	  }, [updateSearchQuery]);
53	
54	  return {
55	    isSearching,
56	    search: updateSearchQuery,
57	  };
58	}

export function getIn(map, keys) {
  let item = map;
  for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    item = item.get(keys[i]);

    if (item == null) {
      return item;
    }
  }
  return item;
}

export function fastSetMerge<T>(set1: Set<T>, set2: Set<T>) {
  const finalSet = new Set(set1);
  const iter = set2.values();
  let value = iter.next();
  while (!value.done) {
    finalSet.add(value.value);
    value = iter.next();
  }
  return finalSet;
}

export function titleFirst(str: string | null | undefined) {
  if (!str || str.length <= 1) {
    return str?.toUpperCase() ?? '';
  }
  return str[0].toUpperCase() + str.slice(1);
}

export function reapplyThousandSeparators(amountText: string) {
  if (!amountText || typeof amountText !== 'string') {
    return amountText;
  }

  const { decimalSeparator, thousandsSeparator, value } = getNumberFormat();
  const [integerPartRaw, decimalPart = ''] = amountText.split(decimalSeparator);

  // Apostrophe-dot: accept both U+2019 and keyboard U+0027 on input (see getNumberFormat formatter)
  const stripThousands =
    value === 'apostrophe-dot'
      ? (s: string) => s.replaceAll(/[\u2019\u0027]/g, '')
      : (s: string) => s.replaceAll(thousandsSeparator, '');
  const numericValue = Number(stripThousands(integerPartRaw));
  if (isNaN(numericValue)) {
    return amountText; // Return original if parsing fails
  }

  const integerPart = numericValue
    .toLocaleString('en-US')
    .replaceAll(',', thousandsSeparator);
  return decimalPart
    ? integerPart + decimalSeparator + decimalPart
    : integerPart;
}

export function appendDecimals(
  amountText: string,
  hideDecimals = false,
): string {
  const { decimalSeparator: separator } = getNumberFormat();
  let result = amountText;
  if (result.slice(-1) === separator) {
    result = result.slice(0, -1);
  }
  if (!hideDecimals) {
    result = result.replaceAll(/[,.]/g, '');
    result = result.replace(/^0+(?!$)/, '');
    result = result.padStart(3, '0');
    result = result.slice(0, -2) + separator + result.slice(-2);
  }
  return amountToCurrency(currencyToAmount(result));
}

const NUMBER_FORMATS = [
  'comma-dot',
  'dot-comma',
  'space-comma',
  'apostrophe-dot',
  'comma-dot',
  'comma-dot-in',
] as const;

export type NumberFormats = (typeof NUMBER_FORMATS)[number];

function isNumberFormat(input: string = ''): input is NumberFormats {
  return (NUMBER_FORMATS as readonly string[]).includes(input);
}

export const numberFormats: Array<{
  value: NumberFormats;
  label: string;
  labelNoFraction: string;
}> = [
  { value: 'comma-dot', label: '1,000.33', labelNoFraction: '1,000' },

export function currencyToInteger(
  currencyAmount: CurrencyAmount,
): IntegerAmount | null {
  const amount = currencyToAmount(currencyAmount);
  return amount == null ? null : amountToInteger(amount);
}

export function stringToInteger(str: string): number | null {
  const amount = parseInt(
    str.replace(/\u2212/g, '-').replace(/[^-0-9.,]/g, ''),
  );
  if (!isNaN(amount)) {
    return amount;
  }
  return null;
}

export function amountToInteger(
  amount: Amount,
  decimalPlaces: number = 2,
): IntegerAmount {
  const multiplier = Math.pow(10, decimalPlaces);
  return Math.round(amount * multiplier);
}

export function integerToAmount(
  integerAmount: IntegerAmount,
  decimalPlaces: number = 2,
): Amount {
  const divisor = Math.pow(10, decimalPlaces);
  return integerAmount / divisor;
}

    `hide-cleared-${params.id}`,
  );
  const [hideReconciled, setHideReconciled] = useSyncedPref(
    `hide-reconciled-${params.id}`,
  );
  const [showExtraBalances, setShowExtraBalances] = useSyncedPref(
    `show-extra-balances-${params.id || 'all-accounts'}`,

  const modalShowing = useSelector(state => state.modals.modalStack.length > 0);

60	
61	export function makeAmountGrey(value: number | string | null): CSSProperties {
62	  return value === 0 || value === '0' || value === '' || value == null
63	    ? { color: theme.budgetNumberZero }
64	    : null;
65	}
66	
67	type BalanceAmountStyleOptions = {
68	  /** Decimal places of the active currency. */
69	  decimalPlaces?: number;
70	  /** Whether the `hideFraction` pref is on. */
71	  hideFraction?: boolean;
72	};
73	
74	export function makeBalanceAmountStyle(
75	  value: number,
76	  goalValue?: number | null,
77	  budgetedValue?: number | null,
78	  { decimalPlaces = 2, hideFraction = false }: BalanceAmountStyleOptions = {},
79	) {
80	  // Balances are integer amounts. Round them to the precision they are
81	  // actually displayed at, so that a balance rendering as zero is greyed out
82	  // rather than coloured, and two amounts rendering identically compare equal
83	  // against a goal.
84	  const scale = hideFraction ? Math.pow(10, decimalPlaces) : 1;
85	
86	  const normalizeIntegerValue = (val: number | null | undefined) =>
87	    typeof val === 'number'
88	      ? Math.sign(val) * Math.round(Math.abs(val) / scale) * scale
89	      : 0;
90	
91	  const currencyValue = normalizeIntegerValue(value);
92	
93	  if (currencyValue < 0) {
94	    return { color: theme.budgetNumberNegative };
95	  }
96	
97	  if (goalValue == null) {
98	    const greyed = makeAmountGrey(currencyValue);
99	    if (greyed) {
100	      return greyed;
101	    }
102	    return { color: theme.budgetNumberPositive };
103	  } else {
104	    const budgetedAmount = normalizeIntegerValue(budgetedValue);
105	    const goalAmount = normalizeIntegerValue(goalValue);
106	
107	    if (budgetedAmount < goalAmount) {
108	      return { color: theme.templateNumberUnderFunded };
109	    }

import { theme } from '@actual-app/components/theme';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import { makeBalanceAmountStyle } from './util';

describe('makeBalanceAmountStyle', () => {
  it('colours by the sign of the balance', () => {
    expect(makeBalanceAmountStyle(-1)).toEqual({
      color: theme.budgetNumberNegative,
    });
    expect(makeBalanceAmountStyle(0)).toEqual({
      color: theme.budgetNumberZero,
    });
    expect(makeBalanceAmountStyle(1)).toEqual({
      color: theme.budgetNumberPositive,
    });
  });

  it('keeps sub-unit balances coloured when the fraction is shown', () => {
    expect(makeBalanceAmountStyle(4, null, null, { decimalPlaces: 2 })).toEqual({
      color: theme.budgetNumberPositive,
    });
  });

  it('greys out a balance that displays as zero when the fraction is hidden', () => {
    expect(
      makeBalanceAmountStyle(4, null, null, {
        decimalPlaces: 2,
        hideFraction: true,
      }),
    ).toEqual({ color: theme.budgetNumberZero });
    expect(
      makeBalanceAmountStyle(-4, null, null, {
        decimalPlaces: 2,
        hideFraction: true,
      }),
    ).toEqual({ color: theme.budgetNumberZero });
  });

  it('does not round away whole units of a zero-decimal currency', () => {
    // 4 is ¥4, not 4 cents, so hiding the fraction must not zero it out.
    expect(
      makeBalanceAmountStyle(4, null, null, {
        decimalPlaces: 0,
        hideFraction: true,
      }),
    ).toEqual({ color: theme.budgetNumberPositive });
  });

  it('compares the budgeted amount against the goal', () => {
    expect(makeBalanceAmountStyle(100, 5000, 4999)).toEqual({
      color: theme.templateNumberUnderFunded,
    });
    expect(makeBalanceAmountStyle(100, 5000, 5000)).toEqual({
      color: theme.templateNumberFunded,
    });
  });

  it('treats amounts that display identically as funded when the fraction is hidden', () => {
    expect(
      makeBalanceAmountStyle(100, 5000, 4999, {
        decimalPlaces: 2,
        hideFraction: true,
      }),
    ).toEqual({ color: theme.templateNumberFunded });
  });
});

import { q } from '@actual-app/core/shared/query';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import { transactionsSearch } from './index';

function amountFilters(search: string, decimalPlaces?: number) {
  const query = transactionsSearch(
    q('transactions'),
    search,
    'MM/dd/yyyy',
    decimalPlaces,
  );

  const [filter] = query.serialize().filterExpressions as Array<{
    $or: { $or: Array<Record<string, unknown>> };
  }>;

  return filter.$or.$or.filter(clause => 'amount' in clause);
}

describe('transactionsSearch', () => {
  it('scales the searched amount at two decimal places by default', () => {
    expect(amountFilters('12.34')).toEqual([
      { amount: { $transform: '$abs', $eq: 1234 } },
    ]);

    expect(amountFilters('12')).toEqual([
      { amount: { $transform: '$abs', $eq: 1200 } },
      { amount: { $transform: { $abs: { $idiv: ['$', 100] } }, $eq: 12 } },
    ]);
  });

  it('scales the searched amount for a zero-decimal currency', () => {
    expect(amountFilters('1200', 0)).toEqual([
      { amount: { $transform: '$abs', $eq: 1200 } },
      { amount: { $transform: { $abs: { $idiv: ['$', 1] } }, $eq: 1200 } },
    ]);
  });

  it('omits the amount filters when the search is not numeric', () => {
    expect(amountFilters('groceries')).toEqual([]);
  });
});

_**Agent (claude-opus-5 2026-09-15 15:57:53-0400)**_

Phase 5 is implemented. Three plain helpers now take the currency's decimal places instead of assuming two.

**[budget/util.ts](packages/desktop-client/src/components/budget/util.ts#L74)** — `makeBalanceAmountStyle` no longer round-trips through `currencyToAmount(integerToCurrency(val))`. It stays in integer space and rounds only when the fraction is actually hidden:

```ts
const scale = hideFraction ? Math.pow(10, decimalPlaces) : 1;
```

I took an options object (`{ decimalPlaces, hideFraction }`) rather than the bare `decimalPlaces` the plan named, because the old string round-trip picked up `hideFraction` implicitly through the global number format — dropping that would have coloured a balance green while it rendered as `0`, a flag-off parity break for anyone with "hide decimal places" on. The `hideFraction` field the plan added to `useFormat` in Phase 0 is exactly what makes that cheap. [BalanceWithCarryover.tsx:120](packages/desktop-client/src/components/budget/BalanceWithCarryover.tsx#L120) passes both (the `useFormat()` call moved above the `useCallback`).

This also fixes a zero-decimal bug the plan didn't call out: under JPY + hideFraction the old code turned ¥4 into `0` and greyed it.

**[queries/index.ts:83](packages/desktop-client/src/queries/index.ts#L83)** — `transactionsSearch` takes `decimalPlaces` (default 2); both `amountToInteger` and the literal `$idiv: ['$', 100]` AQL transform derive from it. [useTransactionsSearch.ts](packages/desktop-client/src/hooks/useTransactionsSearch.ts#L28) calls `useFormat()` itself rather than making its six mobile callers thread a prop; the desktop path goes through `Account.tsx` as a new `decimalPlaces` prop on the class component, supplied from `useFormat()` in the `Account()` wrapper.

**[useFormulaExecution.ts](packages/desktop-client/src/hooks/useFormulaExecution.ts#L131)** — all six `integerToAmount(x, 2)` literals now use a `decimalPlaces` threaded from `useFormat()` down through `prefetchFormulaQueries`, `prefetchBudgetQueries`, and `fetchBudgetDimensionValueDirect`; it's in the effect deps so a currency change re-evaluates.

Added coverage for the two behaviour changes, since neither file had any: [budget/util.test.ts](packages/desktop-client/src/components/budget/util.test.ts) (6 tests, including the JPY + hideFraction case) and [queries/index.test.ts](packages/desktop-client/src/queries/index.test.ts) (3 tests on the emitted filter shape at 2dp and 0dp).

Verification: `yarn typecheck` clean, `yarn test` green except the four pre-existing `mutations.test.tsx` failures you said to ignore. `yarn lint` is clean on code — its only complaints are nine unrelated Markdown files (`STUDENTS.md`, `ai-logs/**`) that fail formatting on the current tree; an earlier `yarn lint:fix` reformatted them, and I reverted that so the diff stays scoped to Phase 5.

Not done, and worth flagging: the plan's manual end-to-end pass (flag-off parity, then JPY/EUR/INR) and the E2E suites. I haven't run the app or `yarn workspace @actual-app/web e2e`. Nothing is committed — Phases 0–4 are still uncommitted alongside this in the working tree.

_**Agent (claude-opus-5 2026-09-15 16:05:27-0400)**_

Phase 6 is done — four cosmetic cleanups, all in `components/reports/`.

**[ReportTableRow.tsx:334](packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/graphs/tableGraph/ReportTableRow.tsx#L334)** — the Average column's tooltip guard was `Math.abs(average / 100) > 100000`, so it only showed the full value above 10,000,000 while the four sibling guards trip at 100,000. Now `Math.abs(average) > 100000`, matching them and dropping the hardcoded scale.

**[BarLineGraph.tsx:111](packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/graphs/BarLineGraph.tsx#L111)** — Y-axis ticks switched from `'financial'` to `'financial-no-decimals'`, which is what all eight other graphs use.

**[AreaGraph.tsx:206](packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/graphs/AreaGraph.tsx#L206)** — the Y-domain rounding now derives its step from `Math.pow(10, format.currency.decimalPlaces)` instead of the literal `100`, so "round to a whole currency unit" is true for JPY as well. The old comment said "nearest 100s", which described the implementation rather than the intent; it now says what it's rounding to.

**Manual `+` signs** — [Change.tsx](packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/Change.tsx#L34) and [SpendingCard.tsx](packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/reports/SpendingCard.tsx#L142) both now pass `'financial-with-sign'`. This resolves the disagreement the plan noted: `Change` prefixed zero with `+`, `SpendingCard` didn't; the format type signs `>= 0`, so `SpendingCard` picks up `+0` and both agree. In `SpendingCard` I also dropped the inner `data &&` — it sits inside an outer `{data && (…)}`, so it was dead.

`yarn typecheck` clean. `yarn lint` clean on code (its only complaints remain the nine unrelated Markdown files that fail formatting in the current tree). `yarn test`: 59 of 60 files pass, with the same four pre-existing `mutations.test.tsx` failures you're ignoring.

Worth flagging, same as last time: I haven't run the manual end-to-end pass or the E2E suites the plan calls for. The `'financial-with-sign'` and tick-formatter changes alter rendered text, so `yarn vrt:docker` is the one most likely to need a look before this ships.

# Writing Release Notes for actualbudget/actual

Release notes are the user-facing changelog. Each code change adds one Markdown file to `upcoming-release-notes/`, and these get collected into the published changelog at the next release. The authoritative source is the **Writing Good Release Notes** section of `packages/docs/docs/contributing/index.md`. Read it if anything below is unclear.

## The file

Create `upcoming-release-notes/<slug>.md`, where `<slug>` is a **short, descriptive kebab-case slug** naming the change (e.g. `add-payee-autocomplete.md`, `fix-mobile-category-delete.md`). Do **not** use a PR number, since the PR link is resolved automatically at release time. (Numeric filenames like `1234.md` still work, but a slug is preferred.)

```markdown
---
category: Features
authors: [YourGitHubUsername]
---

Add payee autocomplete to the transaction entry form
```

- **`category`**: exactly one of `Features` (new feature), `Enhancements` (improvement to an existing feature), `Bugfix` (bug fix), or `Maintenance` (internal change with no user-visible effect).
- **`authors`**: array of the GitHub username(s) who did the work.

## Writing the entry

The body is the changelog line. It is read by everyday users, not developers.

- **One sentence.** Short and clear. No paragraphs, no bullet lists, no long prose.
- **Plain language, no technical detail.** Describe what changed for the user, not how it was built. Avoid file names, function names, internal component names, and implementation jargon. (Exception: `Maintenance` entries may be technical, since they are for internal changes.)
- **Phrase it as a command.** Start with a present-tense verb: "Add …", "Fix …", "Show …", not "Added …" or "Adds …".
- Generally match the PR title, but reword it if that reads more clearly to a user.

Good: `Fix incorrect balance when reconciling an account with future transactions`
Too technical: `Fix off-by-one in reconcileTransactions() when txn.date > today`

if [ ! -d "node_modules" ] || [ "$(ls -A node_modules)" = "" ]; then
    yarn

VRT_ARGS=""

            shift
            ;;
        *)
            VRT_ARGS="$VRT_ARGS $1"
            ;;
    esac

done

_**Agent (claude-opus-5 2026-09-15 16:28:13-0400)**_

The currency feature is no longer experimental, and its controls now live inside the Formatting settings.

**Flag removed** — the `currency` entry is gone from the `FeatureFlag` union in [prefs.ts](packages/loot-core/src/types/prefs.ts#L5), from `DEFAULT_FEATURE_FLAG_STATE` in [useFeatureFlag.ts](packages/desktop-client/src/hooks/useFeatureFlag.ts), and the "Currency support" toggle is out of [Experimental.tsx](packages/desktop-client/src/components/settings/Experimental.tsx). I also deleted the effect in [settings/index.tsx](packages/desktop-client/src/components/settings/index.tsx#L185) that force-wrote `defaultCurrencyCode: ''` on every visit to Settings while the flag was off — that was the mechanism holding the whole feature dormant.

Existing users see no change until they act: `defaultCurrencyCode` stays unset, `getCurrency('')` returns the no-symbol sentinel at 2 decimals, and `applyCurrencyStyling` short-circuits. "None" remains a first-class option in the dropdown, so the feature is opt-in rather than on by default.

**Settings UI** — I read "a section in the formatting settings" as putting currency inside the Formatting block rather than leaving it a sibling section, since choosing a currency already rewrites `numberFormat` and `hideFraction` — the two controls directly below it. [Currency.tsx](packages/desktop-client/src/components/settings/Currency.tsx) now exports `CurrencyFormatSettings`, the columns and checkbox without their own `<Setting>` wrapper, and [Format.tsx](packages/desktop-client/src/components/settings/Format.tsx#L59) renders it as the first row:

```
Currency          Symbol position
[x] Add space between amount and symbol

Numbers           Dates            First day of the week
```

Both rows use the same sidebar-aware breakpoint, so they stack on narrow widths. I retitled `Default Currency` → `Currency` and `Symbol Position` → `Symbol position` to match the sentence-case of the neighbouring column titles, and folded the gist of the old standalone description into the Formatting blurb. Added [Format.test.tsx](packages/desktop-client/src/components/settings/Format.test.tsx) — three tests over real pref providers, covering that the currency controls render in the block and that the spacing checkbox appears only once a currency is set.

Release note at [currency-settings-no-longer-experimental.md](upcoming-release-notes/currency-settings-no-longer-experimental.md). Its `authors` is the placeholder — I don't have your GitHub username, and `gh` isn't installed here, so that and the same placeholder in `currency-display-transactions.md` both need filling in.

`yarn typecheck` and `yarn lint` clean (lint's nine Markdown complaints are the pre-existing unrelated ones). `yarn test:debug`: 60 of 61 files pass, same four `mutations.test.tsx` failures.

Two things you should weigh before this ships:

**The VRT snapshots will fail.** [settings.test.ts](packages/desktop-client/e2e/settings.test.ts#L29) screenshots the whole Settings page in three themes, and the Formatting block has visibly changed. Docker isn't available on this machine, so I couldn't regenerate `chromium-linux` snapshots — that needs `yarn vrt:docker` somewhere with Docker.

**The server side is still hardcoded to two decimals.** The plan deliberately deferred it to a follow-up PR: `getAccountBalance` in the public API, CSV export, YNAB4 import, bank-sync scaling in `app-gocardless/utils.ts` and friends, and account creation at [accounts/app.ts:573](packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts#L573). While the flag was on, only people who opted in could reach those paths with a zero-decimal currency; un-flagging makes JPY/KRW/IRR reachable by anyone who picks them from the dropdown. Nothing breaks for 2-decimal currencies, which is everything except three, but that follow-up is now load-bearing rather than optional.
